prompt_text: I want to try a tanning salon in Charlotte. Which specific salons should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Charlotte NC?
answer_verbatim:
I can put together a short, targeted list — but first a couple quick questions so the suggestions are useful:

1) Which part of Charlotte are you in / what zip code or neighborhood (Uptown, South End, Ballantyne, NoDa, Plaza Midwood, etc.)?  
2) Do you want UV tanning (beds) or a sunless option (spray tan / airbrush / booth)? Any preference for a higher-end “boutique” experience vs. a budget / membership chain?

If you want an immediate, general starting point, here are a few specific types of places to call (and why):

- Palm Beach Tan (several Charlotte locations) — why: large, reliable chain with consistent equipment, membership and single-visit options, usually well-maintained. Good if you want tanning beds and predictable pricing/service. Search for the nearest Charlotte location and call for hours/membership deals.

- Sun Tan City (Charlotte-area locations) — why: another big chain; good for packages, promotions, and different bed strengths. Call to ask about new-customer specials and which rooms they recommend for your skin type.

- Boutique spray-tan studios (example search: “spray tan Charlotte” or “airbrush tan Charlotte”) — why: boutique studios focus on custom blends, experienced artists, and a more natural result. Ask about technicians’ certifications, solution types (organic/hypoallergenic), and portfolio/Instagram photos.

- Local med-spas or dermatology offices that offer sunless tanning / red-light therapy — why: best if you have sensitive skin, medical skin concerns, or want medically supervised treatments. Call to ask about staff credentials and whether they offer patch tests.

- Gyms / fitness clubs with tanning amenities (e.g., some Life Time / YMCA locations) — why: convenient if you already use the gym and often cheaper as part of membership. Ask about equipment age and sanitation policies.

What to ask when you call (so you can compare quickly):
- Do you offer UV tanning beds, spray/airbrush, or sunless booths?  
- What solutions do you use for spray tans (brand/ingredients)? Can I see before/after photos?  
- Are techs/cosmetologists certified for spray tanning?  
- How do you sanitize beds/booths between clients?  
- Do you offer patch tests for sensitivity?  
- Cost: single session, packages, first-time specials, membership fees.  
- Appointment policy / walk-ins accepted? Cancellation fees?

If you tell me your neighborhood and whether you want UV or sunless, I’ll give 5–7 specific salon names in Charlotte with phone numbers, addresses, and exactly why I recommend each one.
